text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research paper focused primarily on national-scale spatial land use/land cover (LULC) prediction for China. The study integrates a national integrated assessment model (Threshold21-China) with a spatial land change model (CLUMondo) to simulate future land system changes from 2000 to 2050 under three distinct scenarios representing different sustainable development pathways. The paper explicitly reports spatially explicit LULC projections mapped at national scale, includes quantitative accuracy metrics (e.g., Kappa statistic = 0.84 for land change simulation validation), and compares scenario outcomes quantitatively. The primary objective is LULC prediction and its influence on terrestrial ecosystem carbon storage, with detailed scenario comparison and spatial modeling. Thus, it meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria. It is not a review article.)
